Lab order creation for prescription lens orders ONLY ??????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? -- Rule: lab_orders are created only when: -- 1. v_kind = 'order' (actual order, not quotation) -- 2. v_type = 'lens' (lens item) -- 3. v_rx is not null (prescription exists) -- This ensures: -- - Frame-only sales (frame sunglasses without prescription) do NOT create lab jobs -- - Quotations do NOT create lab jobs -- - Product/accessory orders do NOT create lab jobs if v_kind = 'order' and v_type = 'lens' and v_rx is not null then insert into lab_orders (branch_id, sale_id, sale_line_id, customer_id, lens_package_id, lens_desc, lens_details, frame_desc, frame_product_id, rx_code, od_sph, od_cyl, od_axis, od_add, os_sph, os_cyl, os_axis, os_add, pd_far, pd_near, due_date) values (v_branch, v_id, v_lid, v_cust, v_pkg.id, v_desc, v_det, v_fdesc, v_fpid, v_rx->>'rx_code', (v_rx->>'od_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'od_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'os_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_far')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_near')::numeric, current_date + v_lead); end if; end loop; -- ?????? Validate lens orders require prescription ???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? if v_kind = 'order' and v_lab and v_rx is null then raise exception 'Lens orders need a prescription. Add one first.'; end if; -- ?????? Update sale totals with all GST aggregates ?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? update sales set subtotal = v_sub, -- FIX: discount_total = listed price ??? what customer pays (always ??? 0) discount_total = greatest(0, round(v_sub - v_grand, 2)), tax_included = v_cgst_tot + v_sgst_tot + v_igst_tot, grand_total = v_grand, taxable_total = v_taxable_tot, cgst_total = v_cgst_tot, sgst_total = v_sgst_tot, igst_total = v_igst_tot, needs_lab = v_lab, status = case when v_kind = 'quotation' then 'draft' when v_lab then 'lab_pending' else 'ready' end, gst_applied = v_gst, supply_type = v_supply_type, state_of_supply = v_state_of_supply, recipient_gstin = v_recipient_gstin, idempotency_key = v_idem::uuid where id = v_id; -- ?????? Convert quotation if referencing one ??????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? if v_qid is not null then update sales set status = 'converted' where id = v_qid; end if; -- ?????? Insert payment if amount provided ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? if v_kind = 'order' and v_pay > 0 then insert into payments (sale_id, amount, method, reference) values (v_id, v_pay, coalesce(p->'payment'->>'method','cash'), nullif(p->'payment'->>'reference','')); end if; return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'code', v_code); end $function$

functions.name: platform_billing_identity
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_billing_identity() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select jsonb_build_object( 'gstin', coalesce((select value #>> '{}' from platform_settings where key = 'saas_gstin'), ''), 'gst_rate_bp', coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::int from platform_settings where key = 'saas_gst_rate_bp'), 1800) ); $function$

functions.name: platform_role
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select platform_role from platform_users where user_id = auth.uid() and is_active limit 1; $function$

functions.name: prescriptions_assign_code
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prescriptions_assign_code() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin new.rx_code := next_code(new.org_id,'rx','RX-'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: prescriptions_check_values
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prescriptions_check_values() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if new.od_axis is not null and new.od_axis not between 0 and 180 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) axis must be between 0 and 180 ??? got %.', new.od_axis; end if; if new.os_axis is not null and new.os_axis not between 0 and 180 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) axis must be between 0 and 180 ??? got %.', new.os_axis; end if; if new.od_sph is not null and new.od_sph not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) SPH is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.od_sph; end if; if new.os_sph is not null and new.os_sph not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) SPH is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.os_sph; end if; if new.od_cyl is not null and new.od_cyl not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) CYL is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.od_cyl; end if; if new.os_cyl is not null and new.os_cyl not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) CYL is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.os_cyl; end if; if new.od_add is not null and new.od_add not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Right eye (OD) ADD is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.od_add; end if; if new.os_add is not null and new.os_add not between -99.99 and 99.99 then raise exception 'Left eye (OS) ADD is out of range (???99.99 to +99.99) ??? got %.', new.os_add; end if; if new.pd_far is not null and new.pd_far not between -999.9 and 999.9 then raise exception 'Distance PD is out of range (???999.9 to +999.9) ??? got %.', new.pd_far; end if; if new.pd_near is not null and new.pd_near not between -999.9 and 999.9 then raise exception 'Near PD is out of range (???999.9 to +999.9) ??? got %.', new.pd_near; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: product_costs_guard
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION product_costs_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if not exists (select 1 from products p where p.id = new.product_id and p.org_id = new.org_id) then raise exception 'Product not in your organisation' using errcode = '42501'; end if; new.updated_at := now(); new.updated_by := auth.uid(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: products_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION products_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.sku := coalesce(nullif(trim(new.sku), ''), next_code(new.org_id, 'sku_' || new.kind, case new.kind when 'frame' then 'FRM-' when 'sunglass' then 'SUN-' when 'contact_lens' then 'CL-' else 'ACC-' end)); new.barcode := coalesce(nullif(new.barcode, ''), new.sku); else new.sku := old.sku; new.updated_at := now(); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: purchase_orders_no
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION purchase_orders_no() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if new.po_no is null or new.po_no = '' then new.po_no := next_code(new.org_id, 'purchase_order', 'PO-'); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: rate_limit_hit
functions.args: p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_secs integer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rate_limit_hit(p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_secs integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare w timestamptz := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / p_window_secs) * p_window_secs); h int; begin insert into rate_limits (key, window_start) values (left(p_key, 200), w) on conflict (key, window_start) do update set hits = rate_limits.hits + 1 returning hits into h; if random() < 0.02 then delete from rate_limits where window_start < now() - interval '1 day'; end if; return h <= p_limit; end $function$

functions.name: receive_transfer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION receive_transfer(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare t branch_transfers; begin select * into t from branch_transfers where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found or t.status <> 'in_transit' then raise exception 'Transfer is not in transit'; end if; if not can_access_branch(t.to_branch) then raise exception 'Only the receiving branch can confirm receipt' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into stock_movements (org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note) values (t.org_id, t.to_branch, t.product_id, t.qty, 'transfer_in', 'Transfer ' || t.id); update branch_transfers set status = 'received', received_by = auth.uid(), received_at = now() where id = t.id; end $function$

functions.name: refresh_subscription_usage
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION refresh_subscription_usage() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_total integer := 0; o record; begin -- The scheduler carries no tenant identity. Clear any residual JWT claims -- (set_config(..., true) is transaction-scoped, so a session can outlive the -- reset role that follows it) so the per-org guard sees a cron/service caller -- instead of a stale authenticated member of some other company. perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true); perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true); for o in select id from organizations loop v_total := v_total + refresh_subscription_usage(o.id); end loop; return v_total; end $function$

functions.name: refresh_subscription_usage
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION refresh_subscription_usage(p_org uuid) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_period timestamptz := date_trunc('month', now()); v_rows integer := 0; r record; begin -- Callers may only refresh their own organisation. Service-role callers -- (cron, platform admin client) have no auth.uid() and pass this guard. if auth.uid() is not null and not exists (select 1 from profiles pr where pr.id = auth.uid() and pr.org_id = p_org) and not exists (select 1 from platform_users pu where pu.user_id = auth.uid() and pu.is_active) then raise exception 'refresh_subscription_usage: organisation mismatch'; end if; for r in select metric, value from org_usage(p_org) loop insert into subscription_usage (org_id, metric, value, period_start, period_end, updated_at) values (p_org, r.metric, r.value, v_period, v_period + interval '1 month', now()) on conflict (org_id, metric, period_start) do update set value = excluded.value, updated_at = now(); v_rows := v_rows + 1; end loop; return v_rows; end $function$

functions.name: remove_org_domain
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_org_domain(p_domain text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can manage domains' using errcode = '42501'; end if; delete from org_domains where domain = lower(trim(p_domain)) and org_id = current_org(); end $function$

functions.name: repairs_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION repairs_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.code := next_code(new.org_id,'repair','REP-'); else new.code := old.code; new.updated_at := now(); end if; new.total_amount := round((new.repair_charges + new.parts_cost - new.discount) * (1 + new.tax_pct/100), 2); return new; end $function$

functions.name: request_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION request_org() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce(current_org(), resolve_org(nullif(current_setting('request.headers', true), '')::json ->> 'x-site-host')) $function$

functions.name: request_transfer
functions.args: p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_product uuid, p_qty integer, p_note text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION request_transfer(p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_product uuid, p_qty integer, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid := current_org(); v_id uuid; begin if v_org is null then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_from = p_to then raise exception 'Choose two different branches'; end if; if not (can_access_branch(p_from) or can_access_branch(p_to)) then raise exception 'Not authorised for these branches' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if (select count(*) from branches where id in (p_from, p_to) and org_id = v_org and is_active) <> 2 then raise exception 'Branches must belong to your organisation'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from products where id = p_product and org_id = v_org) then raise exception 'Product not found'; end if; insert into branch_transfers (org_id, from_branch, to_branch, product_id, qty, note) values (v_org, p_from, p_to, p_product, p_qty, p_note) returning id into v_id; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: require_approved_sale_prescription
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION require_approved_sale_prescription() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_review_status text; v_approved_by uuid; begin if new.prescription_id is null then return new; end if; select review_status, approved_by into v_review_status, v_approved_by from prescriptions where id = new.prescription_id and org_id = new.org_id; if not found then raise exception 'Prescription is not available to this organisation' using errcode = '23503'; end if; if v_review_status is distinct from 'approved' or v_approved_by is null then raise exception 'An optometrist must approve the prescription before a sale can be created' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if; return new; end; $function$

functions.name: resolve_entitlements
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_entitlements(p_org uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_sub record; v_plan record; v_status text; v_features jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; v_limits jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; begin select * into v_sub from org_subscriptions where org_id = p_org order by created_at desc limit 1; if v_sub is null then -- No subscription: minimal read-only entitlements return jsonb_build_object('status','none','features',jsonb_build_object(),'limits',jsonb_build_object('branches',1,'employees',3,'customers',100,'storage_mb',100)); end if; v_status := v_sub.status; -- grace window handling if v_status = 'past_due' and v_sub.grace_ends_at is not null and v_sub.grace_ends_at > now() then v_status := 'grace'; end if; select * into v_plan from billing_plans where id = v_sub.plan_id; if v_plan is null then return jsonb_build_object('status', v_status, 'features', jsonb_build_object(), 'limits', jsonb_build_object()); end if; v_features := coalesce(v_plan.features, '{}'::jsonb); v_limits := jsonb_build_object( 'branches', v_plan.max_branches, 'employees', v_plan.max_employees, 'customers', v_plan.max_customers, 'storage_mb', v_plan.storage_mb ); -- Expired/suspended block writes immediately. Cancelled only blocks once the -- period it already paid for has ended (the daily lifecycle job then moves -- the row to 'expired', so the blocked state never dangles on 'cancelled'). if v_status in ('expired','suspended') or (v_status = 'cancelled' and (v_sub.current_period_end is null or v_sub.current_period_end <= now())) then v_features := v_features || jsonb_build_object('_writes_blocked', true); end if; return jsonb_build_object( 'status', v_status, 'plan_code', v_plan.code, 'plan_name', v_plan.name, 'trial_ends_at', v_sub.trial_ends_at, 'grace_ends_at', v_sub.grace_ends_at, 'current_period_end', v_sub.current_period_end, 'features', v_features, 'limits', v_limits ); end $function$

functions.name: resolve_org
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_org(p_host text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select coalesce((select org_id from site_domains where host = regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_host,'')), '^www\.|:\d+$', '', 'g') limit 1), default_org()) $function$

functions.name: revoke_invitation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_invitation(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can revoke invitations' using errcode = '42501'; end if; update staff_invitations set revoked_at = now() where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() and accepted_at is null; end $function$

functions.name: revoke_temp_assignment
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_temp_assignment(p_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare a staff_assignments; begin select * into a from staff_assignments where id = p_id and org_id = current_org() for update; if not found then raise exception 'Assignment not found'; end if; if not (is_admin() or a.created_by = auth.uid() or (is_manager() and can_access_branch(a.branch_id))) then raise exception 'Not authorised' using errcode = '42501'; end if; update staff_assignments set revoked_at = now(), revoked_by = auth.uid() where id = p_id and revoked_at is null; end $function$

functions.name: run_subscription_lifecycle
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION run_subscription_lifecycle() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_trial_expired int := 0; v_past_due int := 0; v_grace_expired int := 0; v_cancelled int := 0; n int; begin -- 1. Trial ran out. New signups always get a trial (20261203000000), so this is -- the transition that turns an abandoned signup into an expired tenant. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status = 'trialing' and trial_ends_at is not null and trial_ends_at <= now() returning id, org_id, trial_ends_at ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.trial_expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'trial_ends_at', trial_ends_at) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_trial_expired := n; -- 2. Paid period ended and auto-renew did not land -> grace window, not a hard stop. -- grace_days comes from the plan (default 7) so the platform sets the policy. update org_subscriptions s set status = 'past_due', grace_ends_at = now() + make_interval(days => coalesce(p.grace_days, 7)), updated_at = now() from billing_plans p where s.plan_id = p.id and s.status in ('active', 'payment_pending') and s.current_period_end is not null and s.current_period_end <= now() and (s.grace_ends_at is null or s.grace_ends_at <= now()); get diagnostics n = row_count; v_past_due := n; -- Same transition for a subscription with no plan attached: fall back to 7 days. update org_subscriptions set status = 'past_due', grace_ends_at = now() + make_interval(days => 7), updated_at = now() where plan_id is null and status in ('active', 'payment_pending') and current_period_end is not null and current_period_end <= now() and (grace_ends_at is null or grace_ends_at <= now()); get diagnostics n = row_count; v_past_due := v_past_due + n; -- 3. Grace window over -> expired. Writes stop, everything else stays reachable. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', grace_ends_at = null, updated_at = now() where status = 'past_due' and grace_ends_at is not null and grace_ends_at <= now() returning id, org_id, grace_ends_at ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'grace_ended_at', grace_ends_at) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_grace_expired := n; -- 4. Cancelled at the end of the period it already paid for. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status = 'cancelled' and current_period_end is not null and current_period_end <= now() returning id, org_id, current_period_end ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'period_end', current_period_end) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_cancelled := n; return jsonb_build_object( 'ok', true, 'trial_expired', v_trial_expired, 'moved_to_past_due', v_past_due, 'grace_expired', v_grace_expired, 'cancelled_expired', v_cancelled); end $function$

functions.name: sale_events_track
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sale_events_track() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then insert into sale_events (org_id, sale_id, from_status, to_status, note) values (new.org_id, new.id, null, new.status, case when new.kind = 'quotation' then 'Quotation created' else 'Order placed' end); elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then insert into sale_events (org_id, sale_id, from_status, to_status, note) values (new.org_id, new.id, old.status, new.status, null); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: sales_before
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_before() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new.code := next_code(new.org_id, 'sale_' || new.kind, case new.kind when 'quotation' then 'Q-' else 'ORD-' end); else new.code := old.code; new.updated_at := now(); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: sales_trend
functions.returns: TABLE(day date, amount numeric, orders integer)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_trend(p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 14) RETURNS TABLE(day date, amount numeric, orders integer) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ select g::date, coalesce(sum(s.grand_total), 0), count(s.id)::int from generate_series((now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - (least(greatest(p_days, 1), 90) - 1), (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, interval '1 day') g left join sales s on s.kind = 'order' and s.status <> 'cancelled' and (s.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = g::date and (p_branch is null or s.branch_id = p_branch) and s.org_id = current_org() group by 1 order by 1 $function$

functions.name: save_eye_examination
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION save_eye_examination(p_data jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); v_user uuid:=auth.uid(); v_customer uuid; v_appt uuid; v_branch uuid; v_rx uuid; v_exam uuid; v_row eye_examinations%rowtype; v_valid date; begin if v_org is null or v_user is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501'; end if; v_customer := (p_data->>'customer_id')::uuid; v_appt := nullif(p_data->>'appointment_id','')::uuid; if not exists(select 1 from customers where id=v_customer and org_id=v_org) then raise exception 'Customer not found' using errcode='42501'; end if; if v_appt is not null then select branch_id into v_branch from appointments where id=v_appt and org_id=v_org and customer_id=v_customer; if not found then raise exception 'Appointment not found for this customer'; end if; else v_branch := nullif(p_data->>'branch_id','')::uuid; end if; if v_branch is null or not can_access_branch(v_branch) then raise exception 'No access to examination branch' using errcode='42501'; end if; if nullif(p_data->>'od_sph','') is not null or nullif(p_data->>'os_sph','') is not null then v_valid := current_date + make_interval(months => greatest(1,least(60,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'next_review_months','')::int,24)))); insert into prescriptions(org_id,branch_id,customer_id,rx_type,od_sph,od_cyl,od_axis,od_add,os_sph,os_cyl,os_axis,os_add,pd_far,pd_near,rx_date,valid_till,examined_by,remarks) values(v_org,v_branch,v_customer,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'rx_type',''),'single_vision'),nullif(p_data->>'od_sph','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'od_cyl','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'od_axis','')::int,nullif(p_data->>'od_add','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_sph','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_cyl','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_axis','')::int,nullif(p_data->>'os_add','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'pd_far','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'pd_near','')::numeric,now(),v_valid,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'examiner_name',''),'Staff'),p_data->>'notes') returning id into v_rx; end if; select jsonb_populate_record(null::eye_examinations, p_data || jsonb_build_object('id',gen_random_uuid(),'org_id',v_org,'branch_id',v_branch,'prescription_id',v_rx,'created_at',now(),'updated_at',now())) into v_row; insert into eye_examinations select v_row.* returning id into v_exam; if v_appt is not null then update appointments set status='completed',updated_at=now() where id=v_appt and org_id=v_org; end if; return v_exam; end $function$

functions.name: seed_org_permissions
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION seed_org_permissions(p_org uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ insert into role_permissions (org_id, role_key, permission) select p_org, r, c.key from permission_catalog c, unnest(c.default_roles) r where r in ('branch_manager', 'staff', 'optometrist', 'sales_executive', 'cashier', 'inventory_manager', 'lab_technician', 'accountant', 'receptionist') on conflict do nothing $function$

functions.name: set_branch_active
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_branch_active(p_branch uuid, p_active boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); v_fallback uuid; begin if v_org is null or not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can change branch status' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_active is null then raise exception 'Choose an active status'; end if; perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_org::text, 0)); perform 1 from branches where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org for update; if not found then raise exception 'Branch not found' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_active then update branches set is_active=true where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; if not exists(select 1 from branches where org_id=v_org and is_default_pickup) then update branches set is_default_pickup=true where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; end if; else if (select count(*) from branches where org_id=v_org and is_active)>1 then if exists(select 1 from branches where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org and is_default_pickup) then select id into v_fallback from branches where org_id=v_org and id<>p_branch and is_active order by code,id limit 1; update branches set is_default_pickup=false where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; update branches set is_default_pickup=true where id=v_fallback; end if; update branches set is_active=false where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; else raise exception 'An organisation must keep at least one active branch'; end if; end if; end $function$

functions.name: set_default_pickup_branch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_default_pickup_branch(p_branch uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); begin if v_org is null or not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can change the pickup branch' using errcode='42501'; end if; perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_org::text, 0)); if not exists(select 1 from branches where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org and is_active) then raise exception 'Choose an active branch'; end if; update branches set is_default_pickup=false where org_id=v_org and is_default_pickup and id<>p_branch; update branches set is_default_pickup=true where org_id=v_org and id=p_branch; end $function$

functions.name: set_profile_branches
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_profile_branches(p_profile uuid, p_branches uuid[]) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare c profiles; t profiles; b uuid; begin select * into c from profiles where id = auth.uid() and is_approved and not deactivated; if not found or c.role_key not in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Only an owner or admin can change branch access' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into t from profiles where id = p_profile and org_id = c.org_id; if not found then raise exception 'Staff member not found'; end if; if t.role_key in ('owner', 'admin') then raise exception 'Owners and admins already see every branch'; end if; foreach b in array coalesce(p_branches, '{}') loop if not exists (select 1 from branches where id = b and org_id = c.org_id and is_active) then raise exception 'Branch not in your organisation'; end if; end loop; delete from profile_branches where profile_id = p_profile and branch_id <> all (coalesce(p_branches, '{}')); insert into profile_branches (profile_id, branch_id, org_id) select p_profile, x, c.org_id from unnest(coalesce(p_branches, '{}')) x on conflict do nothing; insert into audit_log (org_id, user_id, table_name, action, new_data) values (c.org_id, auth.uid(), 'profile_branches', 'set', jsonb_build_object('profile', p_profile, 'branches', p_branches)); end $function$

functions.name: set_referral_code
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_referral_code() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if new.referral_code is null then new.referral_code := 'PE'||upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,6)); end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: set_role_permission
functions.args: p_role text, p_permission text, p_allowed boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_role_permission(p_role text, p_permission text, p_allowed boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can change permissions' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_role not in ('branch_manager', 'staff', 'optometrist', 'sales_executive', 'cashier', 'inventory_manager', 'lab_technician', 'accountant', 'receptionist') or p_allowed is null or not exists(select 1 from permission_catalog where key=p_permission) then raise exception 'Invalid role permission'; end if; insert into role_permissions(org_id, role_key, permission, allowed) values(current_org(), p_role, p_permission, p_allowed) on conflict(org_id, role_key, permission) do update set allowed = excluded.allowed, updated_by = auth.uid(), updated_at = now(); end $function$

functions.name: set_whatsapp_log_branch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_whatsapp_log_branch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if new.branch_id is null and new.customer_id is not null then select branch_id into new.branch_id from customers where id=new.customer_id and org_id=new.org_id; end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: settle_subscription_payment
functions.args: p_org_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid, p_provider_order_id text, p_provider_payment_id text, p_amount_minor bigint, p_provider text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION settle_subscription_payment(p_org_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid, p_provider_order_id text, p_provider_payment_id text, p_amount_minor bigint, p_provider text DEFAULT 'razorpay'::text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_invoice subscription_invoices%rowtype; v_sub org_subscriptions%rowtype; v_plan billing_plans%rowtype; v_end timestamptz; begin select * into v_invoice from subscription_invoices where (p_invoice_id is not null and id = p_invoice_id) or (p_invoice_id is null and p_provider_order_id is not null and provider_order_id = p_provider_order_id) limit 1; if not found then raise exception 'subscription invoice not found'; end if; if p_org_id is not null and v_invoice.org_id <> p_org_id then raise exception 'subscription invoice belongs to another organisation'; end if; -- Replay / double callback: settle exactly once, report success either way. if v_invoice.status = 'paid' then return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already_paid', true, 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'org_id', v_invoice.org_id); end if; -- provider_payment_id is UNIQUE, so a concurrent replay lands here and is ignored. begin insert into subscription_payments (invoice_id, org_id, provider, provider_payment_id, status, amount_minor) values (v_invoice.id, v_invoice.org_id, p_provider, p_provider_payment_id, 'succeeded', p_amount_minor); exception when unique_violation then null; end; update subscription_invoices set status = 'paid', paid_at = coalesce(paid_at, now()) where id = v_invoice.id; select * into v_plan from billing_plans where id = v_invoice.plan_id; if found then v_end := now() + case when v_plan.interval = 'year' then interval '1 year' else interval '1 month' end; select * into v_sub from org_subscriptions where org_id = v_invoice.org_id order by created_at desc limit 1; if not found then insert into org_subscriptions (org_id, plan_id, status, provider, provider_subscription_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, auto_renew) values (v_invoice.org_id, v_plan.id, 'active', p_provider, p_provider_payment_id, now(), v_end, true); else update org_subscriptions set plan_id = v_plan.id, status = 'active', provider = p_provider, provider_subscription_id = p_provider_payment_id, current_period_start = case when current_period_end is null or current_period_end < now() then now() else current_period_start end, current_period_end = greatest(coalesce(current_period_end, now()), now()) + case when v_plan.interval = 'year' then interval '1 year' else interval '1 month' end, auto_renew = true, cancelled_at = null, grace_ends_at = null, reactivated_at = case when status in ('cancelled','expired','suspended') then now() else reactivated_at end where id = v_sub.id; end if; end if; insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) values (v_invoice.org_id, 'subscription.payment_succeeded', jsonb_build_object( 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'provider_order_id', v_invoice.provider_order_id, 'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id, 'amount_minor', p_amount_minor, 'plan_id', v_invoice.plan_id)); return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already_paid', false, 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'org_id', v_invoice.org_id); end $function$

functions.name: sp_touch
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sp_touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at := now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: start_stock_audit
functions.args: p_branch uuid, p_title text, p_products uuid[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION start_stock_audit(p_branch uuid, p_title text, p_products uuid[]) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_session uuid; v_org uuid := current_org(); begin if auth.uid() is null or v_org is null or not has_perm('stock_audit') or not can_access_branch(p_branch) then raise exception 'Not authorised to start a stock count' using errcode='42501'; end if; if length(trim(p_title)) not between 2 and 120 or coalesce(array_length(p_products,1),0) not between 1 and 2000 then raise exception 'Enter a title and at least one product'; end if; if exists (select 1 from unnest(p_products) x group by x having count(*) > 1) then raise exception 'Duplicate products in stock count'; end if; if exists (select 1 from unnest(p_products) x left join products p on p.id=x and p.org_id=v_org and p.status='active' where p.id is null) then raise exception 'One or more products are unavailable'; end if; insert into stock_audit_sessions(org_id,branch_id,title,started_by) values(v_org,p_branch,trim(p_title),auth.uid()) returning id into v_session; insert into stock_audit_lines(org_id,session_id,product_id,expected_qty) select v_org,v_session,p.id,coalesce(k.qty,0) from products p left join stock k on k.product_id=p.id and k.branch_id=p_branch where p.id=any(p_products) and p.org_id=v_org; return v_session; end $function$

functions.name: sync_auth_to_customer
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_auth_to_customer() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid; v_br uuid; v_name text; v_phone text; v_meta text := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'org_id'; begin if (new.raw_user_meta_data->>'is_staff') = 'true' then insert into profiles (id, full_name) values (new.id, coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(new.email, '@', 1))) on conflict (id) do nothing; return new; end if; if exists (select 1 from customers where auth_user_id = new.id) then return new; end if; if v_meta ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then select id into v_org from organizations where id = v_meta::uuid; end if; if v_org is null then select id into v_org from organizations order by created_at limit 1; end if; if v_org is null then return new; end if; select id into v_br from branches where org_id = v_org and is_active order by name limit 1; v_name := coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), split_part(new.email, '@', 1), 'Customer'); v_phone := coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone'), ''), ''); insert into customers (org_id, branch_id, full_name, phone, email, auth_user_id, notes) values (v_org, v_br, v_name, v_phone, new.email, new.id, 'Auto-created from website portal'); return new; end $function$

functions.name: touch_pi_updated
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION touch_pi_updated() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: touch_po_updated
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION touch_po_updated() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $function$

functions.name: trg_org_seed_permissions
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trg_org_seed_permissions() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin perform seed_org_permissions(new.id); return new; end $function$

functions.name: realtime.apply_rls
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer DEFAULT (1024 * 1024)) RETURNS SETOF realtime.wal_rls LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare -- Regclass of the table e.g. notes entity_ regclass = (quote_ident(wal ->> 'schema') || '.' || quote_ident(wal ->> 'table'))::regclass; -- I, U, D, T: insert, update ... action realtime.action = ( case wal ->> 'action' when 'I' then 'INSERT' when 'U' then 'UPDATE' when 'D' then 'DELETE' else 'ERROR' end ); -- Is row level security enabled for the table is_rls_enabled bool = relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = entity_; subscriptions realtime.subscription[] = array_agg(subs) from realtime.subscription subs where subs.entity = entity_ -- Filter by action early - only get subscriptions interested in this action -- action_filter column can be: '*' (all), 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', or 'DELETE' and (subs.action_filter = '*' or subs.action_filter = action::text); -- Subscription vars working_role regrole; working_selected_columns text[]; claimed_role regrole; claims jsonb; subscription_id uuid; subscription_has_access bool; visible_to_subscription_ids uuid[] = '{}'; -- structured info for wal's columns columns realtime.wal_column[]; -- previous identity values for update/delete old_columns realtime.wal_column[]; error_record_exceeds_max_size boolean = octet_length(wal::text) > max_record_bytes; -- Primary jsonb output for record output jsonb; -- Loop record for iterating unique roles (outer loop) role_record record; -- Loop record for iterating unique selected_columns within a role (inner loop) cols_record record; -- Subscription ids visible at the role level (before fanning out by selected_columns) visible_role_sub_ids uuid[] = '{}'; begin perform set_config('role', null, true); columns = array_agg( ( x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', realtime.cast( (x->'value') #>> '{}', coalesce( (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4 (x->>'type')::regtype ) ), (pks ->> 'name') is not null, true )::realtime.wal_column ) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name'); old_columns = array_agg( ( x->>'name', x->>'type', x->>'typeoid', realtime.cast( (x->'value') #>> '{}', coalesce( (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4 (x->>'type')::regtype ) ), (pks ->> 'name') is not null, true )::realtime.wal_column ) from jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name'); for role_record in select claims_role from (select distinct claims_role from unnest(subscriptions)) t order by claims_role::text loop working_role := role_record.claims_role; -- Update `is_selectable` for columns and old_columns (once per role) columns = array_agg( ( c.name, c.type_name, c.type_oid, c.value, c.is_pkey, pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT') )::realtime.wal_column ) from unnest(columns) c; old_columns = array_agg( ( c.name, c.type_name, c.type_oid, c.value, c.is_pkey, pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT') )::realtime.wal_column ) from unnest(old_columns) c; if action <> 'DELETE' and count(1) = 0 from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then -- Fan out 400 error per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; return next ( jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action ), is_rls_enabled, (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)), array['Error 400: Bad Request, no primary key'] )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; -- The claims role does not have SELECT permission to the primary key of entity elsif action <> 'DELETE' and sum(c.is_selectable::int) <> count(1) from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then -- Fan out 401 error per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; return next ( jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action ), is_rls_enabled, (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)), array['Error 401: Unauthorized'] )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; else -- Create the prepared statement (once per role) if is_rls_enabled and action <> 'DELETE' then if (select 1 from pg_prepared_statements where name = 'walrus_rls_stmt' limit 1) > 0 then deallocate walrus_rls_stmt; end if; execute realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('walrus_rls_stmt', entity_, columns); end if; -- Collect all visible subscription IDs for this role (filter check + RLS check) visible_role_sub_ids = '{}'; for subscription_id, claims in ( select subs.subscription_id, subs.claims from unnest(subscriptions) subs where subs.entity = entity_ and subs.claims_role = working_role and ( realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns, subs.filters) or ( action = 'DELETE' and realtime.is_visible_through_filters(old_columns, subs.filters) ) ) ) loop if not is_rls_enabled or action = 'DELETE' then visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id; else -- Check if RLS allows the role to see the record perform -- Trim leading and trailing quotes from working_role because set_config -- doesn't recognize the role as valid if they are included set_config('role', trim(both '"' from working_role::text), true), set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims::text, true); execute 'execute walrus_rls_stmt' into subscription_has_access; -- Reset the role on every FOR..LOOP batch execution. -- The first batch of 10 rows is pre-fetched using the current connection role (PG internal behaviour) -- then we have to reset it again otherwise it would use the role defined in the `set_config` above -- to fetch the remaining rows when rows>10, which could be a user-defined role that lacks execution grants. -- The flow is: -- 1. run batch with conn role -- 2. set_config working_role -- 3. execute walrus -- 4. reset role (revert) -- 5. repeat perform set_config('role', null, true); if subscription_has_access then visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id; end if; end if; end loop; perform set_config('role', null, true); -- Inner loop: per distinct selected_columns for this role for cols_record in select selected_columns from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '') loop working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns; output = jsonb_build_object( 'schema', wal ->> 'schema', 'table', wal ->> 'table', 'type', action, 'commit_timestamp', to_char( ((wal ->> 'timestamp')::timestamptz at time zone 'utc'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' ), 'columns', ( select jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'name', pa.attname, 'type', pt.typname ) order by pa.attnum asc ) from pg_attribute pa join pg_type pt on pa.atttypid = pt.oid left join ( select unnest(conkey) as pkey_attnum from pg_constraint where conrelid = entity_ and contype = 'p' ) pk on pk.pkey_attnum = pa.attnum where attrelid = entity_ and attnum > 0 and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, pa.attname, 'SELECT') and (working_selected_columns is null or pa.attname = any(working_selected_columns) or pk.pkey_attnum is not null) ) ) -- Add "record" key for insert and update || case when action in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then jsonb_build_object( 'record', ( select jsonb_object_agg( -- if unchanged toast, get column name and value from old record coalesce((c).name, (oc).name), case when (c).name is null then (oc).value else (c).value end ) from unnest(columns) c full outer join unnest(old_columns) oc on (c).name = (oc).name where coalesce((c).is_selectable, (oc).is_selectable) and (working_selected_columns is null or coalesce((c).name, (oc).name) = any(working_selected_columns) or coalesce((c).is_pkey, (oc).is_pkey)) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) ) ) else '{}'::jsonb end -- Add "old_record" key for update and delete || case when action = 'UPDATE' then jsonb_build_object( 'old_record', ( select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value) from unnest(old_columns) c where (c).is_selectable and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) ) ) when action = 'DELETE' then jsonb_build_object( 'old_record', ( select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value) from unnest(old_columns) c where (c).is_selectable and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey) and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64)) and ( not is_rls_enabled or (c).is_pkey ) -- if RLS enabled, we can't secure deletes so filter to pkey ) ) else '{}'::jsonb end; -- Filter visible_role_sub_ids to those matching the current selected_columns group visible_to_subscription_ids = coalesce( ( select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns) and s.subscription_id = any(visible_role_sub_ids) ), '{}'::uuid[] ); return next ( output, is_rls_enabled, visible_to_subscription_ids, case when error_record_exceeds_max_size then array['Error 413: Payload Too Large'] else '{}' end )::realtime.wal_rls; end loop; end if; end loop; perform set_config('role', null, true); end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.broadcast_changes
functions.args: topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.broadcast_changes(topic_name text, event_name text, operation text, table_name text, table_schema text, new record, old record, level text DEFAULT 'ROW'::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE -- Declare a variable to hold the JSONB representation of the row row_data jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; BEGIN IF level = 'STATEMENT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'function can only be triggered for each row, not for each statement'; END IF; -- Check the operation type and handle accordingly IF operation = 'INSERT' OR operation = 'UPDATE' OR operation = 'DELETE' THEN row_data := jsonb_build_object('old_record', OLD, 'record', NEW, 'operation', operation, 'table', table_name, 'schema', table_schema); PERFORM realtime.send (row_data, event_name, topic_name); ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unexpected operation type: %', operation; END IF; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Failed to process the row: %', SQLERRM; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql
functions.args: prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[]
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql(prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[]) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $function$ /* Builds a sql string that, if executed, creates a prepared statement to tests retrive a row from *entity* by its primary key columns. Example select realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('notes', '{"id"}'::text[], '{"bigint"}'::text[]) */ select 'prepare ' || prepared_statement_name || ' as select exists( select 1 from ' || entity || ' where ' || string_agg(quote_ident(pkc.name) || '=' || quote_nullable(pkc.value #>> '{}') , ' and ') || ' )' from unnest(columns) pkc where pkc.is_pkey group by entity $function$

functions.name: realtime.cast
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime."cast"(val text, type_ regtype) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ declare res jsonb; begin if type_::text = 'bytea' then return to_jsonb(val); end if; execute format('select to_jsonb(%L::'|| type_::text || ')', val) into res; return res; end $function$

functions.name: realtime.check_equality_op
functions.args: op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.check_equality_op(op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ /* Casts *val_1* and *val_2* as type *type_* and check the *op* condition for truthiness */ declare op_symbol text = ( case when op = 'eq' then '=' when op = 'neq' then '!=' when op = 'lt' then '<' when op = 'lte' then '<=' when op = 'gt' then '>' when op = 'gte' then '>=' when op = 'in' then '= any' else 'UNKNOWN OP' end ); res boolean; begin execute format( 'select %L::'|| type_::text || ' ' || op_symbol || ' ( %L::' || ( case when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]' else type_::text end ) || ')', val_1, val_2) into res; return res; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.check_equality_op
functions.args: op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text, negate boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.check_equality_op(op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text, negate boolean) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $function$ declare op_symbol text; res boolean; begin -- IS DISTINCT FROM / IS NOT DISTINCT FROM: infix, both sides typed literals if op = 'isdistinct' then execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %L::%s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT DISTINCT FROM' else 'IS DISTINCT FROM' end, val_2, type_::text ) into res; return res; end if; -- IS requires a keyword RHS (NULL, TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN), not a typed literal if op = 'is' then if val_2 not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT' else 'IS' end, upper(val_2) ) into res; return res; end if; op_symbol = case when op = 'eq' then '=' when op = 'neq' then '!=' when op = 'lt' then '<' when op = 'lte' then '<=' when op = 'gt' then '>' when op = 'gte' then '>=' when op = 'in' then '= any' when op = 'like' then 'LIKE' when op = 'ilike' then 'ILIKE' when op = 'match' then '~' when op = 'imatch' then '~*' else null end; if op_symbol is null then raise exception 'unsupported equality operator: %', op::text; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s (%L::%s)', val_1, type_::text, op_symbol, val_2, case when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]' else type_::text end ) into res; return case when negate then not res else res end; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.is_visible_through_filters
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns realtime.wal_column[], filters realtime.user_defined_filter[]) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ select filters is null or array_length(filters, 1) is null or coalesce( count(col.name) = count(1) and sum( realtime.check_equality_op( op:=f.op, type_:=coalesce(col.type_oid::regtype, col.type_name::regtype), val_1:=col.value #>> '{}', val_2:=f.value, negate:=coalesce(f.negate, false) )::int ) filter (where col.name is not null) = count(col.name), false ) from unnest(filters) f left join unnest(columns) col on f.column_name = col.name; $function$

functions.name: realtime.list_changes
functions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
functions.returns: TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer) RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal' AS $function$ WITH pub AS ( SELECT concat_ws( ',', CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END ) AS w2j_actions, coalesce( string_agg( realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass), ',' ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL), '' ) AS w2j_add_tables FROM pg_publication pp LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname WHERE pp.pubname = publication GROUP BY pp.pubname LIMIT 1 ), -- MATERIALIZED ensures pg_logical_slot_get_changes is called exactly once w2j AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables FROM pub, pg_logical_slot_get_changes( slot_name, null, max_changes, 'include-pk', 'true', 'include-transaction', 'false', 'include-timestamp', 'true', 'include-type-oids', 'true', 'format-version', '2', 'actions', pub.w2j_actions, 'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables ) x ), slot_count AS ( SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM w2j WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> '' ), rls_filtered AS ( SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors FROM w2j, realtime.apply_rls( wal := w2j.data::jsonb, max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors) WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> '' AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc UNION ALL SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt FROM slot_count sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered) $function$

functions.name: realtime.list_changes_sync
functions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
functions.returns: TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes_sync(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer) RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal' AS $function$ WITH pub AS ( SELECT concat_ws( ',', CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END ) AS w2j_actions, coalesce( string_agg( realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass), ',' ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL), '' ) AS w2j_add_tables FROM pg_publication pp LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname WHERE pp.pubname = publication GROUP BY pp.pubname LIMIT 1 ), -- MATERIALIZED ensures the slot is read exactly once. consumed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables FROM pub, realtime.settled_changes( slot_name, max_changes, 'include-pk', 'true', 'include-transaction', 'false', 'include-timestamp', 'true', 'include-type-oids', 'true', 'format-version', '2', 'actions', pub.w2j_actions, 'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables ) x ), slot_count AS ( SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM consumed WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> '' ), rls_filtered AS ( SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors FROM consumed, realtime.apply_rls( wal := consumed.data::jsonb, max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors) WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> '' AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc UNION ALL SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt FROM slot_count sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered) $function$

functions.name: realtime.quote_wal2json
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.quote_wal2json(entity regclass) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $function$ SELECT realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(nsp.nspname::text) || '.' || realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(pc.relname::text) FROM pg_class pc JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON pc.relnamespace = nsp.oid WHERE pc.oid = entity $function$

functions.name: realtime.send
functions.args: payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.send(payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE generated_id uuid; final_payload jsonb; BEGIN BEGIN generated_id := gen_random_uuid(); -- Check if payload has an 'id' key, if not, add the generated UUID IF payload ? 'id' THEN final_payload := payload; ELSE final_payload := jsonb_set(payload, '{id}', to_jsonb(generated_id)); END IF; -- Set the topic configuration EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL realtime.topic TO %L', topic); INSERT INTO realtime.messages (id, payload, event, topic, private, extension) VALUES (generated_id, final_payload, event, topic, private, 'broadcast'); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'WarnSendingBroadcastMessage: %', SQLERRM; END; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.send_binary
functions.args: payload bytea, event text, topic text, private boolean
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.send_binary(payload bytea, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE generated_id uuid; BEGIN BEGIN generated_id := gen_random_uuid(); EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL realtime.topic TO %L', topic); INSERT INTO realtime.messages (id, binary_payload, event, topic, private, extension) VALUES (generated_id, payload, event, topic, private, 'broadcast'); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'WarnSendingBroadcastMessage: %', SQLERRM; END; END; $function$

functions.name: realtime.settled_changes
functions.args: slot_name name, max_changes integer, VARIADIC opts text[]
functions.returns: TABLE(lsn pg_lsn, xid xid, data text)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.settled_changes(slot_name name, max_changes integer, VARIADIC opts text[]) RETURNS TABLE(lsn pg_lsn, xid xid, data text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare upto pg_lsn; total bigint; xids xid[]; starts bigint[]; snapshot pg_snapshot; running_xids xid[]; xmax_age int; cut bigint; begin -- Each statement in a volatile function takes its own snapshot, which is what lets the -- check below see a writer that was still in flight when the peek ran. Under REPEATABLE -- READ the snapshot never advances, so a deferred change would never be released. if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then raise exception 'realtime.settled_changes requires READ COMMITTED'; end if; -- The peek and the read below cover the same WAL, so the read cannot reach a commit the -- check never saw. upto := pg_current_wal_flush_lsn(); -- One entry per transaction, in commit order: its xid and the position of its first -- change. The peek uses the caller's own options, so max_changes counts exactly what the -- read counts. A non-transactional logical message is emitted as soon as it is decoded, -- tagged with the xid of whatever transaction wrote it, so it does not mark where that -- transaction starts. select coalesce(sum(g.n), 0), array_agg(g.x order by g.first) filter (where g.first is not null), array_agg(g.first order by g.first) filter (where g.first is not null) into total, xids, starts from ( select p.xid as x, count(*) as n, min(p.ord) filter (where not case when starts_with(p.data, '{"action":"M"') then (p.data::jsonb->>'transactional')::boolean is false else false end) as first from pg_logical_slot_peek_changes(slot_name, upto, max_changes, variadic opts) with ordinality as p(lsn, xid, data, ord) group by p.xid ) g; -- Nothing for the caller, but the slot still has to move past what the peek covered. if total = 0 then perform pg_replication_slot_advance(slot_name, upto); return; end if; if xids is not null then -- Taken after the peek is materialized, so a writer that was still in flight during -- decoding is guaranteed to show up here. snapshot := pg_current_snapshot(); -- A commit record reaches the WAL before the writer leaves the proc array, so a change -- can be decoded while its row is invisible. apply_rls would resolve a policy against a -- row it cannot see and authorize it for nobody, while the read consumed it regardless. -- -- xip lists transactions running when the snapshot was taken. It does not cover a writer -- whose xid sits at or beyond xmax, which never appears there, so the horizon is checked -- too. age() counts backwards from the current xid and so compares correctly across -- wraparound. select coalesce(array_agg(running.x::xid), array[]::xid[]) into running_xids from pg_snapshot_xip(snapshot) running(x); xmax_age := age(pg_snapshot_xmax(snapshot)::xid); select min(u.s) into cut from unnest(xids, starts) as u(x, s) where u.x = any(running_xids) or age(u.x) <= xmax_age; end if; -- The read stops right after the commit that brings its count to upto_nchanges, so the -- count of changes in front of the first unsettled transaction stops it just before that -- transaction. if cut is null then return query select p.* from pg_logical_slot_get_changes(slot_name, upto, max_changes, variadic opts) p; elsif cut > 1 then return query select p.* from pg_logical_slot_get_changes(slot_name, upto, (cut - 1)::int, variadic opts) p; end if; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.subscription_check_filters
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.subscription_check_filters() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ declare col_names text[] = coalesce( array_agg(a.attname order by a.attnum), '{}'::text[] ) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = new.entity and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege( (new.claims ->> 'role'), a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'SELECT' ); filter realtime.user_defined_filter; col_type regtype; in_val jsonb; selected_col text; begin for filter in select * from unnest(new.filters) loop if not filter.column_name = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for filter %', filter.column_name; end if; col_type = ( select atttypid::regtype from pg_catalog.pg_attribute where attrelid = new.entity and attname = filter.column_name ); if col_type is null then raise exception 'failed to lookup type for column %', filter.column_name; end if; if filter.op = 'in'::realtime.equality_op then in_val = realtime.cast(filter.value, (col_type::text || '[]')::regtype); if coalesce(jsonb_array_length(in_val), 0) > 100 then raise exception 'too many values for `in` filter. Maximum 100'; end if; elsif filter.op = 'is'::realtime.equality_op then -- `is` requires a keyword RHS rather than a typed literal if filter.value not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; -- IS NULL works for any type, but IS TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN require a boolean -- operand. Reject the non-null keywords on non-boolean columns here so they -- don't abort apply_rls at WAL time. if filter.value <> 'null' and col_type <> 'boolean'::regtype then raise exception 'is % filter requires a boolean column, got %', filter.value, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('like'::realtime.equality_op, 'ilike'::realtime.equality_op) then -- like/ilike apply the text pattern operator (~~); reject column types that -- have no such operator instead of failing at WAL time if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = '~~' and oprleft = col_type ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('match'::realtime.equality_op, 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op) then -- match/imatch apply the regex operators ~ / ~*; reject column types that have -- no such operator (e.g. integer) instead of failing at WAL time, mirroring the -- like/ilike guard above. if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = case when filter.op = 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op then '~*' else '~' end and oprleft = col_type and oprright = col_type and oprresult = 'boolean'::regtype ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; -- validate the regex eagerly so a bad pattern is rejected here, not inside -- apply_rls where it would abort the WAL stream for the entity begin perform '' ~ filter.value; exception when others then raise exception 'invalid regular expression for % filter: %', filter.op::text, sqlerrm; end; else -- eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte: value must be coercable to the type perform realtime.cast(filter.value, col_type); end if; end loop; if new.selected_columns is not null then for selected_col in select * from unnest(new.selected_columns) loop if not selected_col = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for select %', selected_col; end if; end loop; end if; -- Apply consistent order to filters so the unique constraint can't be tricked by a -- different filter order. negate is part of the sort key. new.filters = coalesce( array_agg(f order by f.column_name, f.op, f.value, f.negate), '{}' ) from unnest(new.filters) f; -- Normalize selected_columns order so ARRAY['a','b'] and ARRAY['b','a'] are treated -- as the same subscription group in apply_rls. Preserve an empty array as '{}' -- ("primary keys only") so it stays distinct from NULL ("all columns"); array_agg -- over an empty set would otherwise collapse '{}' back to NULL. if new.selected_columns is not null then new.selected_columns = coalesce( ( select array_agg(c order by c) from unnest(new.selected_columns) c ), '{}'::text[] ); end if; return new; end; $function$

functions.name: realtime.to_regrole
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.to_regrole(role_name text) RETURNS regrole LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ select role_name::regrole $function$

functions.name: realtime.topic
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.topic() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ select nullif(current_setting('realtime.topic', true), '')::text; $function$

functions.name: realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.wal2json_escape_identifier(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $function$ -- Prefix `\`, `,`, `.`, and any whitespace with `\` SELECT regexp_replace(name, '([\\,.[:space:]])', '\\\1', 'g') $function$

functions.name: storage.allow_any_operation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_any_operation(expected_operations text[]) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH current_operation AS ( SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation ), normalized AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9) ELSE raw_operation END AS current_operation FROM current_operation ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM normalized n CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(expected_operations) AS expected_operation WHERE expected_operation IS NOT NULL AND expected_operation <> '' AND n.current_operation = CASE WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9) ELSE expected_operation END ); $function$

functions.name: storage.allow_only_operation
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_only_operation(expected_operation text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH current_operation AS ( SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation ), normalized AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9) ELSE raw_operation END AS current_operation, CASE WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9) ELSE expected_operation END AS requested_operation FROM current_operation ) SELECT CASE WHEN requested_operation IS NULL OR requested_operation = '' THEN FALSE ELSE COALESCE(current_operation = requested_operation, FALSE) END FROM normalized; $function$

functions.name: storage.can_insert_object
functions.args: bucketid text, name text, owner uuid, metadata jsonb
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.can_insert_object(bucketid text, name text, owner uuid, metadata jsonb) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO "storage"."objects" ("bucket_id", "name", "owner", "metadata") VALUES (bucketid, name, owner, metadata); -- hack to rollback the successful insert RAISE sqlstate 'PT200' using message = 'ROLLBACK', detail = 'rollback successful insert'; END $function$

functions.name: storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog' AS $function$ BEGIN IF current_user::text IS DISTINCT FROM TG_ARGV[0] AND ( OLD.lifecycle_configuration IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.lifecycle_configuration OR OLD.lifecycle_configuration_generation IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.lifecycle_configuration_generation ) THEN -- AFTER runs only after caller RLS has accepted the proposed row. The API -- recognizes this specific error after rolling back its permission probe; -- direct non-service writes still fail and cannot persist the change. RAISE EXCEPTION 'bucket control columns may only be changed by the configured storage service role' USING ERRCODE = 'PST01', SCHEMA = TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE = TG_TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT = TG_NAME; END IF; RETURN NULL; END; $function$

functions.name: storage.enforce_bucket_name_length
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_name_length() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ begin if length(new.name) > 100 then raise exception 'bucket name "%" is too long (% characters). Max is 100.', new.name, length(new.name); end if; return new; end; $function$

functions.name: storage.extension
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ DECLARE _parts text[]; _filename text; BEGIN -- Split on "/" to get path segments SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts; -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename) SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename; -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1)); END $function$

functions.name: storage.filename
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.filename(name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ DECLARE _parts text[]; BEGIN SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts; RETURN _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)]; END $function$

functions.name: storage.foldername
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text) RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ DECLARE _parts text[]; BEGIN -- Split on "/" to get path segments SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts; -- Return everything except the last segment RETURN _parts[1 : array_length(_parts,1) - 1]; END $function$

functions.name: storage.get_common_prefix
functions.args: p_key text, p_prefix text, p_delimiter text
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.get_common_prefix(p_key text, p_prefix text, p_delimiter text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $function$ SELECT CASE WHEN p_delimiter <> '' AND position(p_delimiter IN substring(p_key FROM length(p_prefix) + 1)) > 0 THEN left( p_key, length(p_prefix) + position(p_delimiter IN substring(p_key FROM length(p_prefix) + 1)) + length(p_delimiter) - 1 ) ELSE NULL END; $function$

functions.name: storage.get_size_by_bucket
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.get_size_by_bucket(noncurrent_versions text DEFAULT 'include'::text, delete_markers text DEFAULT 'include'::text) RETURNS TABLE(size bigint, bucket_id text) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $function$ BEGIN -- COALESCE first: NULL NOT IN (...) evaluates to NULL (not TRUE), so a -- bare NOT IN check silently leaves an explicit NULL argument unreset. noncurrent_versions := COALESCE(noncurrent_versions, 'include'); delete_markers := COALESCE(delete_markers, 'include'); IF noncurrent_versions NOT IN ('exclude', 'only', 'include') THEN noncurrent_versions := 'include'; END IF; IF delete_markers NOT IN ('exclude', 'only', 'include') THEN delete_markers := 'include'; END IF; return query select sum((metadata->>'size')::bigint)::bigint as size, obj.bucket_id from "storage".objects as obj where (noncurrent_versions != 'exclude' OR obj.archived_at IS NULL) and (noncurrent_versions != 'only' OR obj.archived_at IS NOT NULL) and (delete_markers != 'exclude' OR NOT obj.is_delete_marker) and (delete_markers != 'only' OR obj.is_delete_marker) group by obj.bucket_id; END $function$

functions.name: storage.list_multipart_uploads_with_delimiter
functions.args: bucket_id text, prefix_param text, delimiter_param text, max_keys integer, next_key_token text, next_upload_token text, raw_prefix_param text
functions.returns: TABLE(key text, id text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.list_multipart_uploads_with_delimiter(bucket_id text, prefix_param text, delimiter_param text, max_keys integer DEFAULT 100, next_key_token text DEFAULT ''::text, next_upload_token text DEFAULT ''::text, raw_prefix_param text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(key text, id text, created_at timestamp with time zone) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH candidates AS ( SELECT upload.key AS object_key, CASE WHEN position($3 IN substring(upload.key FROM length(coalesce($7, $2)) + 1)) > 0 THEN left( upload.key, length(coalesce($7, $2)) + position($3 IN substring(upload.key FROM length(coalesce($7, $2)) + 1)) + length($3) - 1 ) ELSE upload.key END AS result_key, upload.id, upload.created_at, position($3 IN substring(upload.key FROM length(coalesce($7, $2)) + 1)) > 0 AS is_common_prefix FROM storage.s3_multipart_uploads AS upload WHERE upload.bucket_id = $1 AND upload.key COLLATE "C" LIKE $2 || '%' ), filtered AS ( SELECT candidate.* FROM candidates AS candidate WHERE $5 = '' OR candidate.result_key COLLATE "C" > $5 OR ( candidate.result_key COLLATE "C" = $5 AND NOT candidate.is_common_prefix AND $6 <> '' -- A completed or aborted marker repeats the remaining same-key uploads. AND COALESCE( (candidate.created_at, candidate.id COLLATE "C") > ( SELECT marker.created_at, marker.id COLLATE "C" FROM storage.s3_multipart_uploads AS marker WHERE marker.bucket_id = $1 AND marker.key COLLATE "C" = $5 AND marker.id = $6 ), TRUE ) ) ), ranked AS ( SELECT filtered.*, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY filtered.result_key COLLATE "C" ORDER BY filtered.created_at, filtered.id COLLATE "C" ) AS prefix_rank FROM filtered ) SELECT ranked.result_key, ranked.id, ranked.created_at FROM ranked WHERE NOT ranked.is_common_prefix OR ranked.prefix_rank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.result_key COLLATE "C", ranked.created_at, ranked.id COLLATE "C" LIMIT $4; $function$
